{{Top|leg}}
Under '''Section 2127''' of the [[Imperial Penal Code/Legends|Imperial Penal Code]], [[Imperial Assassin]]s were required to notify their target that they had been hired to conduct a legal assassination in order to atone for crimes against [[Human/Legends|Humanity]] committed by that party. The code then required the assassin to provide the victim a weapon, since they had the legal right to defend themselves, and wait three minutes before attempting to kill them, as they had to be given an opportunity to escape.

[[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], also known as "Payback", followed this code.
